questions.stem: Let f(x) = x² + 3x. What is (f(2) − f(0)) / 2?
questions.explain: f(2) = 4 + 6 = 10 and f(0) = 0, so the value is 10 / 2 = 5. This is the average slope between x = 0 and x = 2.

questions.stem: Let f(x) = x² + 2x. For which x is f′(x) = 4?

questions.explain: An antiderivative of 3x² is x³. Evaluating from 0 to 2 gives 2³ − 0³ = 8.

questions.stem: Consider f(x) = |x| on the interval [−1, 1]. Which statement is true?
options: It is continuous on [−1, 1] but not differentiable at x = 0
It is differentiable at every point of (−1, 1)
It is not continuous at x = 0
It is neither continuous nor differentiable at x = 0
questions.explain: The graph of |x| has no break, so it is continuous. At x = 0 the slope is −1 from the left and +1 from the right, so there is a corner and no derivative.
